data.summary:
Whenever an **AELDARI** unit of yours arrives from **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**, it can be placed anywhere entirely within 6" of the Webway Gate. If it is:

- it can be placed closer than 9" to enemy models, even inside their **Engagement Range**
- if it ends up in Engagement Range of an enemy model this way, then this turn it is **eligible to fight** and counts as having finished a **Charge move**
